Because the Blessed One's joints are not protruding, his calves are beautiful. Because they are supple, his gait is attractive.","kind":"sense","why":"The English translates the final sentence as 'his gait is attractive', but the source says 'his gait is unattractive' (འགྲོས་སྡུག་པ་ཡིན་ནོ།).","certainty":"high"}],"omissions":[],"additions":[]}

contradictions.english: Because they are not supple, walking is uncomfortable and the gait becomes unattractive. Because the Blessed One's joints are not protruding, his calves are beautiful. Because they are supple, his gait is attractive.
contradictions.why: The English translates the final sentence as 'his gait is attractive', but the source says 'his gait is unattractive' (འགྲོས་སྡུག་པ་ཡིན་ནོ།).
